verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut has GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations that update Shortcut "while you work." That describes one-way updates from code activity. Nothing documents syncing tasks with a repository's issue tracker (such as GitHub Issues) in both directions. The integration is an adjacent feature, not evidence of the story's capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
